summary: --dry-run hard-failed instead of previewing the request for APIs whose base_url has unresolved per-tenant template vars ({shop}/{api_version}); fixed at the client-framework level (not Shopify-specific) so --dry-run always shows a request preview.
reason: buildURL() rejected unresolved {placeholder} vars before the DryRun branch ever ran, and separately Client.dryRun's REST-shaped {"dry_run": true} stub broke GraphQL callers that unwrap resp.Data, and separately autoRefreshIfStale ignored --dry-run entirely and made a live network call. All three combined meant --dry-run against an unconfigured shop (no SHOPIFY_SHOP/SHOPIFY_API_VERSION) failed hard instead of previewing anything, which also broke narrative validation for every quickstart/recipe example on this CLI.
validated_outcome: shopify-pp-cli orders list --first 10 --json --dry-run now prints the request preview and a valid JSON envelope with exit 0 instead of failing with a template-var error; validate-narrative --strict --full-examples passes for all quickstart/recipe entries.
